```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, out.width = "100%")
library(DT)
d <- readRDS(params$data_path)
species <- d$what == "species"
res <- d$result
# The conclusion right after the name, the evidence after it
res <- res[, c(names(res)[1], "Conclusion", setdiff(names(res)[-1], "Conclusion"))]
n_none <- sum(grepl("^No (names|records) found", res$Conclusion))
logo_path <- system.file("figures", "floraR_hex_sticker.png", package = "floraR")
```

```{r intro, results="asis"}
fun <- if (species) "flora_species_gap()" else "flora_distribution_gap()"
src <- d$sources
src <- if (length(src) > 1) paste(paste(src[-length(src)], collapse = ", "), "and", src[length(src)]) else src
cat(if (species) {
  paste0("The ", nrow(res), " genera below were searched with <code>", fun, "</code> in ",
         src, ", and **no species missing from the FFB ",
         "checklist** was found: every species-level name with evidence of occurring in ",
         "Brazil is already in FFB. No spreadsheet or detailed report was written for them.")
} else {
  paste0("The ", nrow(res), " taxa below were searched with <code>", fun, "</code> in ",
         src, ", and **no candidate new state or ",
         "phytogeographic domain record** was found: every record falls within the ",
         "distribution already listed by FFB. No spreadsheet or detailed report was ",
         "written for them.")
}, "\n\n")
if (n_none > 0) {
  cat("**Note:** for ", n_none, " of them nothing at all was found in the searched ",
      "databases, so the result says nothing about their distribution - check the ",
      "spelling of the name.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

DT::datatable(

  colnames = gsub("_", " ", names(res)),
